sloka: दशग्रीव तथा यत्नं कुरुष्वामितविक्रम ।यथा त्वमसि मे पुत्र भव र्वैश्रवणोपमः ।। ७.९.४३ ॥
transliteration: daśagrīva tathā yatnaṁ kuruṣvāmitavikrama ।yathā tvamasi me putra bhava rvaiśravaṇopamaḥ ।। 7.9.43 ॥

translations.english: "O Dashagriva, O one of immeasurable valor, make such an effort, my son, so that you become equal to Vaishravana."
